description: This Python source file contains utilities for converting between A2A message formats and OpenAI message formats, as well as functions for generating streaming events such as task creation, status updates, and artifact updates within an A2A communication protocol.

classes.name: A2AStreamingContext
classes.description: Holds the state and context for A2A streaming interactions, including task identifiers, message accumulation, and flags indicating emitted events.

classes.name: A2ACompletionBridgeTransformation
classes.description: Provides static methods for transforming messages and generating event payloads between A2A and OpenAI formats, as well as streaming events.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] a2a_message_to_openai_messages( a2a_message: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Converts an A2A message to a list of OpenAI-compatible message dicts, mapping roles and concatenating text parts.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] openai_response_to_a2a_response( response: Any, request_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms a LiteLLM ModelResponse object into an A2A compatible response message, embedding the content inside the appropriate A2A message structure.

methods.name: str _get_timestamp()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC timestamp in ISO format.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_task_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, )
methods.description: Creates the initial task creation event for A2A streaming, indicating the task has been submitted.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_status_update_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, state: str, final: bool = False, message_text: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Generates a status update event (e.g., working, completed) with optional message content for the agent.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_artifact_update_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, text: str, )
methods.description: Constructs an artifact update event containing response content.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] openai_chunk_to_a2a_chunk( chunk: Any, request_id: Optional[str] = None, is_final: bool = False, )
methods.description: Legacy method converting a streamed LiteLLM chunk into an A2A streaming format, primarily for non-event-based streaming.
